This document does not contain passwords, tokens, secrets, or system credentials.

factual_sources.text:
Account Sharing

Employees must not share passwords, MFA codes, access tokens, or accounts. Each employee is responsible for activity performed under their account.

Admin Account Handling

Admin accounts must be separate from normal user accounts. Admin access should use MFA, approved device posture, and session logging where supported.

This document does not contain passwords, tokens, secrets, or system credentials.

Company Devices

Employees who regularly access company systems should use a company-managed device. Company devices must have disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and current operating system updates.

Employees may not disable security tools or remove device management controls from company devices.

Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.

Privileged Access Review

Privileged access must be reviewed monthly for production systems and quarterly for business applications. Reviewers must confirm business need, manager approval, and least-privilege alignment.

Privileged access exceptions require an owner, expiration date, and documented business justification.
